name: Mage
fantasy: The runecaster. Draws sigils, throws bolts that take on the kin's nature, and runs dangerously hot.

passive.name: Overload (Heat)
passive.desc: RMB adds 20 Heat (a hold 35), E adds 25; it cools after 1.2s. At 70+ you're Overcharged: RMB and E +25% damage and radius, bolts pierce. At 100 you Vent: a 0.4s ring, then a 3m nova (14, push 9), Heat 0, RMB locked 1s.

dash.name: Blink
dash.desc: A 0.12s windup (everyone sees the sigil where you'll land), then you teleport up to 5.5m, through walls, never into the abyss. A rune left behind bursts 0.6s later: slow.

variants.tap: A bolt 10m: 14 damage and a slow (your kin's nature changes the slow).
variants.hold: Lance: a 14m beam, 24 damage, pierces; you're slowed while it charges and foes see the line.
variants.air: Starfall: a bolt into the ground under you: 10 damage, push 7, lifts you 2m and cools the glider.
variants.during_e: Through your Sigil a bolt splits into 3; a Lance chains to 2 more.

e.name: Sigil
e.desc: Draw a 3m rune up to 9m away for 6s: allies inside move 15% faster and your bolts split through it. Press E again to detonate: a 0.3s flash, then 10 damage and a lift.

r.name: Meteor
r.desc: Aim a 4m circle up to 14m: 1.0s of a burning rock coming down, then 30 damage and a lift; anyone already in the air is spiked (+50%, stun 0.8). Burning ground for 2s. Cast Overcharged and your Heat resets without a Vent.

tells.full: white-hot runes, steam at 90+, then the Vent ring
tells.dash_spent: the departure rune, dash pip dark
